Question_text: Enzymes are used commercially to extract juice from apples. You will investigate the effect of an enzyme on the extraction of apple juice.
Construct a table to record the appearance and volume of juice collected from each mixture.
With reference to your results, compare the volume and appearance of the two juices extracted.
Explain why the following procedures were carried out: (i) washing the plastic spoon; (ii) stirring the mixtures; (iii) adding 5 cm³ of water in the test-tube labelled ‘no enzyme'.

Question_text: Fig. 3.1 shows a hand of an orang-utan (not to scale), a mammal that lives in trees.

Describe three visible similarities between your hand and that of the orang-utan shown in Fig. 3.1. (ii) Describe two visible differences between your hand and that of the orang-utan shown in Fig. 3.1.

The hairs on the skin can play a part in maintaining a constant internal body temperature in a mammal. Describe one way, not involving hairs, in which the skin helps to lower the internal body temperature when it rises above normal.
